children: Sri Lankan shares closed lower on Wednesday, dragged by communications and consumer discretionary stocks.
were the biggest drag on the index, down 2.98% and 4.86%, respectively, on the day.
* Trading volume on the index rose to 101.8 million shares from 78.9 million shares in the previous session.
* The equity market's turnover rose to 1.9 billion Sri Lankan rupees ($5.74 million) from 1.15 billion rupees in the previous session, according to exchange data.
* Foreign investors were net sellers, offloading stocks worth 46.5 million rupees, while domestic investors were net buyers, purchasing shares worth 1.86 billion rupees, the data showed.
